headline: Iran designates UK Royal Navy and RAF as terrorist organisations, MI6 as hostile group
dek: Iran's Foreign Ministry designated Britain's Royal Navy and Royal Air Force as terrorist organisations and MI6 as a 'hostile group', effective Nov 1, under a Supreme National Security Council resolution — reciprocal to the UK's July 13, 2026 listing of the IRGC under the State Threats Act 2026 and…
sources: Iranian Foreign Ministry statement, via Tasnim / Mehr News Agency
fault_line: Legal escalation vs empty label: does putting the Royal Navy on a terrorist list change anything at sea near Hormuz, or is it pure reciprocal theatre?

sections.what_happened: Iran's Foreign Ministry designated Britain's Royal Navy and Royal Air Force as terrorist organisations and MI6 as a 'hostile group', effective Nov 1, under a Supreme National Security Council resolution — reciprocal to the UK's July 13, 2026 listing of the IRGC under the State Threats Act 2026 and to alleged British provision of bases/logistics during the US-Israeli war on Iran. The UK Ministry of Defence responded: 'We utterly reject this designation.' The ministry stated no practical consequence (no detention, prosecution or enforcement action named).
sections.what_verified: The claim IS the primary source's own statement (Iranian Foreign Ministry, T1 national officials on record); Tasnim/Mehr carry no declared tier in the source registry and therefore do not add a corroboration family; Anadolu's relay repeats the same statement.
sections.what_disputed: UK MoD rejects the designation outright and says UK forces will continue to defend UK personnel and interests with allies. No quantified practical effect exists to test: the ministry did not say what the designations mean in practice, so no hidden-constraint metric can be proven — recorded as null rather than invented.
sections.why_matters: Iran just put Britain's Navy and Air Force on its terrorist list — the legal tripwire for any future UK detention near Hormuz.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Iran FM statement Sun Nov 1; surfaced via IC Brief Nov 2 morning, absent from all prior Nov 2 scans) -- Iran designates UK Royal Navy and RAF as terrorist organisations, MI6 as hostile group

totw_analysis: Our read: Iran just put Britain's Navy and Air Force on its terrorist list — the legal tripwire for any future UK detention near Hormuz. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Legal escalation vs empty label: does putting the Royal Navy on a terrorist list change anything at sea near Hormuz, or is it pure reciprocal theatre?
